message.text:
r01.
There is no Redis connection configuration: the cache is an in-memory `cache.Cache`. User entries use the shared default TTL of 10 minutes, configured when `Store` constructs `userCache` — [store/store.go:28](/bench/repo/store/store.go#L28), [store/store.go:41](/bench/repo/store/store.go#L41), [store/cache/cache.go:66](/bench/repo/store/cache/cache.go#L66).
